# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System Taskbar**: Located at the top of the screen, showing system icons and the current time.
  - **Left Side**: Contains application launcher icons including Google Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC Media Player, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, and others.
  - **Right Side**: Contains system status icons including network, sound, and power.
- **Application Title Bar**: Displays the name of the application and the current document.
  - **Application Name**: "LibreOffice Impress"
  - **Document Name**: "ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx - LibreOffice Impress"
  - **Date and Time**: "Oct 22 19:36"
  - **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons on the far right.

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Options**: Located directly below the title bar.
  - **File**
  - **Edit** (currently active, dropdown menu open)
  - **View**
  - **Insert**
  - **Format**
  - **Slide**
  - **Slide Show**
  - **Tools**
  - **Window**
  - **Help**

## Edit Menu Dropdown

- **Dropdown Menu Items**:
  - **Undo** (Ctrl+Z)
  - **Redo** (Ctrl+Y)
  - **Cut** (Ctrl+X)
  - **Copy** (Ctrl+C)
  - **Paste** (Ctrl+V)
  - **Paste Special** (with right arrow indicating submenu)
  - **Duplicate...** (Shift+F3)
  - **Select All** (Ctrl+A)
  - **Find...** (Ctrl+F)
  - **Find and Replace...** (Ctrl+H)
  - **Points**
  - **Gluepoints**
  - **Hyperlink**
  - **Fields...**
  - **Links to External Files...**
  - **Object** (with right arrow indicating submenu)
  - **Edit Mode** (Shift+Ctrl+M, with downward arrow indicating submenu)

## Toolbar

- **Main Toolbar**: Located below the menu bar, containing various icons for common actions.
  - **Undo/Redo** icons
  - **Cut/Copy/Paste** icons
  - **Text formatting icons** (bold, italic, underline, font color, etc.)
  - **Drawing tools** (shapes, lines, arrows, etc.)
  - **Insert icons** (image, chart, table, etc.)
  - **Slide management icons** (new slide, duplicate, delete, etc.)
  - **View icons** (zoom, full screen, etc.)
  - **Other icons** (alignment, formatting, etc.)

## Slide Area

- **Slide Content**:
  - **Title**: "ASIS&T STRATEGIC PLANNING TOWN HALL MEETING"
  - **Subtitle**: "SEPTEMBER 29 and OCTOBER 1, 2015"
  - **Footer**: "asis&t" logo with text "Association for Information Science and Technology"
- **Slide Number Indicator**: "Slide 1 of 18" at the bottom left.

## Sidebar

- **Slide Thumbnails**: Located on the left side of the screen, showing thumbnails of all slides in the presentation.
  - **Slide 1**: Title slide
  - **Slide 2**: Blank
  - **Slide 3**: Blank
  - **Slide 4**: Blank
  - **Slide 5**: "HOW DID WE GET HERE?"
  - **Slide 6**: "WHAT DO WE NEED FROM YOU?"
  - **Slide 7**: "DISCUSSING THE STRATEGIC PLAN"
  - **Slide 8**: "5 STRATEGIC DIRECTIONS"
  - **Slide 9**: "1. MEMBERSHIP"
  - **Slide 10**: Blank
- **Properties Panel**: Located on the right side of the screen.
  - **Slide Properties**:
    - **Format**: "Widescreen"
    - **Orientation**: "Landscape"
    - **Background**: "None" (with "Insert Image..." button)
    - **Master Slide**: "Title Slide"
    - **Master Background**: Checked
    - **Master Objects**: Checked
    - **Master View** button
  - **Layouts**:
    - **Layout Selection**: A grid of layout options, with one layout selected (highlighted with a red border).
    - **Layout Options**: Various layout templates for slides, including title and content layouts.

## Status Bar

- **Bottom of the Screen**:
  - **Slide Number**: "Slide 1 of 18"
  - **Title Slide** indicator
  - **Position Coordinates**: "-0.52 / -1.87
